ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the lateral margins and distal tips of both lobes. Dark low-intensity core extending from the center outward, interspersed with fine white stippling/mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the left lobe margin. Right lobe margin exhibits low-frequency, high-amplitude jagged irregularities, including a significant rectangular-shaped indentation on the upper outer edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curves tapering to acute, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, horizontal low-contrast linear marks visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged truncation/notch on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy high-intensity pixel encrustations on distal tips indicative of persistent surface trauma or colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, multi-pointed texture on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes composed of dense, high-contrast pixel clusters.
